dialogues.speaker: "Cataclysm"
dialogues.text: I heard this thing was terribly ineffective when first invented. You could only catch ten in a week — why, the research staff barely wanted to touch it, let alone improve it.

dialogues.speaker: "Apocalypse"
dialogues.text: But for some reason, it gained traction among adventurers once it entered the market.

dialogues.speaker: "Cataclysm"
dialogues.text: True. It takes time, it beats having to do it yourself, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: "Apocalypse"
dialogues.text: But there are so many Crystalflies around here. Surely it's not that difficult to just do it the old-fashioned way?

dialogues.speaker: "Cataclysm"
dialogues.text: It's a bit far, though. Just imagine how tiresome it was back in the day, having to come out here over and over again, and no gadget to help.

dialogues.speaker: "Cataclysm"
dialogues.text: ...Does that count as trespassing on private property, I wonder?

dialogues.speaker: "Apocalypse"
dialogues.text: I suppose it hardly matters anymore. Adventurers aren't quite so keen on Crystalflies nowadays.
